title: Even subsequence limit of normalized influence
statement: For every integer $k>0$, as $m$ tends to infinity through the nonnegative integers, the total influence of the degree-$k$ Gotsman–Linial extremizer on the $(k+2m)$-dimensional Boolean cube, divided by $\sqrt{k+2m}$, tends to $k\sqrt{2/\pi}$.
